method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Hakbal decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Hakbal pages, then filtered for Merfolk and explore. Game Changers excluded.
summary: The Marvel sets gave Merfolk a lot: Attuma and both Namors are already the most-played new cards in recent Hakbal lists. Namor, Scourge of the Seas is especially good here because Hakbal puts +1/+1 counters on every Merfolk. The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.
